sections.en: I think the word 'part of fortune' in this whole chapter is to be understood concerning the part of marriage.

summary.headline: Part of Marriage
summary.text: Astrological judgments on the part of marriage and its lord: angular or benefic placements promise marriage to beautiful, virtuous women, while cadent, malefic, retrograde, or combust conditions signify depraved or fruitless unions and lust. Venus, Saturn, Jupiter, the Moon, the ascendant, and the seventh and tenth houses are invoked as further indicators.
